verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلسَّنَةِ ٱلثَّانِيَةِ مِنْ مُلْكِ نَبُوخَذْنَصَّرَ، حَلَمَ نَبُوخَذْنَصَّرُ أَحْلَامًا، فَٱنْزَعَجَتْ رُوحُهُ وَطَارَ عَنْهُ نَوْمُهُ.
verses.kjv: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.
verses.web: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

verses.ar: فَأَمَرَ ٱلْمَلِكُ بِأَنْ يُسْتَدْعَى ٱلْمَجُوسُ وَٱلسَّحَرَةُ وَٱلْعَرَّافُونَ وَٱلْكَلْدَانِيُّونَ لِيُخْبِرُوا ٱلْمَلِكَ بِأَحْلَامِهِ. فَأَتَوْا وَوَقَفُوا أَمَامَ ٱلْمَلِكِ.
verses.kjv: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.
verses.web: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَلِكُ: «قَدْ حَلَمْتُ حُلْمًا وَٱنْزَعَجَتْ رُوحِي لِمَعْرِفَةِ ٱلْحُلْمِ».
verses.kjv: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
verses.web: The king said to them, “I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.”

verses.ar: فَكَلَّمَ ٱلْكَلْدَانِيُّونَ ٱلْمَلِكَ بِٱلْأَرَامِيَّةِ: «عِشْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلِكُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. أَخْبِرْ عَبِيدَكَ بِٱلْحُلْمِ فَنُبَيِّنَ تَعْبِيرَهُ».
verses.kjv: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.
verses.web: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ ٱلْمَلِكُ وَقَالَ لِلْكَلْدَانِيِّينَ: «قَدْ خَرَجَ مِنِّي ٱلْقَوْلُ: إِنْ لَمْ تُنْبِئُونِي بِٱلْحُلْمِ وَبِتَعْبِيرِهِ، تُصَيَّرُونَ إِرْبًا إِرْبًا وَتُجْعَلُ بُيُوتُكُمْ مَزْبَلَةً.
verses.kjv: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
verses.web: The king answered the Chaldeans, “The thing has gone from me. If you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut in pieces, and your houses will be made a dunghill.

verses.ar: وَإِنْ بَيَّنْتُمُ ٱلْحُلْمَ وَتَعْبِيرَهُ، تَنَالُونَ مِنْ قِبَلِي هَدَايَا وَحَلَاوِينَ وَإِكْرَامًا عَظِيمًا. فَبَيِّنُوا لِي ٱلْحُلْمَ وَتَعْبِيرَهُ».
verses.kjv: But if ye shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.web: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.”

verses.ar: فَأَجَابُوا ثَانِيَةً وَقَالُوا: «لِيُخْبِرِ ٱلْمَلِكُ عَبِيدَهُ بِٱلْحُلْمِ فَنُبَيِّنَ تَعْبِيرَهُ».
verses.kjv: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.
verses.web: They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

verses.ar: أَجَابَ ٱلْمَلِكُ وَقَالَ: «إِنِّي أَعْلَمُ يَقِينًا أَنَّكُمْ تَكْتَسِبُونَ وَقْتًا، إِذْ رَأَيْتُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْقَوْلَ قَدْ خَرَجَ مِنِّي
verses.kjv: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.
verses.web: The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.

verses.ar: بِأَنَّهُ إِنْ لَمْ تُنْبِئُونِي بِٱلْحُلْمِ فَقَضَاؤُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ. لِأَنَّكُمْ قَدِ ٱتَّفَقْتُمْ عَلَى كَلَامٍ كَذِبٍ وَفَاسِدٍ لِتَتَكَلَّمُوا بِهِ قُدَّامِي إِلَى أَنْ يَتَحَوَّلَ ٱلْوَقْتُ. فَأَخْبِرُونِي بِٱلْحُلْمِ، فَأَعْلَمَ أَنَّكُمْ تُبَيِّنُونَ لِي تَعْبِيرَهُ».
verses.kjv: But if ye will not make known unto me the dream, [there is but] one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can shew me the interpretation thereof.
verses.web: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation.”

verses.ar: أَجَابَ ٱلْكَلْدَانِيُّونَ قُدَّامَ ٱلْمَلِكِ وَقَالُوا: «لَيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِنْسَانٌ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يُبَيِّنَ أَمْرَ ٱلْمَلِكِ. لِذَلِكَ لَيْسَ مَلِكٌ عَظِيمٌ ذُو سُلْطَانٍ سَأَلَ أَمْرًا مِثْلَ هَذَا مِنْ مَجُوسِيٍّ أَوْ سَاحِرٍ أَوْ كَلْدَانِيٍّ.
verses.kjv: ¶ The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king’s matter: therefore [there is] no king, lord, nor ruler, [that] asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.
verses.web: The Chaldeans answered the king and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler has asked such a thing of any magician, enchanter, or Chaldean.

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَمْرُ ٱلَّذِي يَطْلُبُهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ عَسِرٌ، وَلَيْسَ آخَرُ يُبَيِّنُهُ قُدَّامَ ٱلْمَلِكِ غَيْرَ ٱلْآلِهَةِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَيْسَتْ سُكْنَاهُمْ مَعَ ٱلْبَشَرِ».
verses.kjv: And [it is] a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
verses.web: It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.”

verses.ar: لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ غَضِبَ ٱلْمَلِكُ وَٱغْتَاظَ جِدًّا وَأَمَرَ بِإِبَادَةِ كُلِّ حُكَمَاءِ بَابِلَ.
verses.kjv: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise [men] of Babylon.
verses.web: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.

verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ ٱلْأَمْرُ، وَكَانَ ٱلْحُكَمَاءُ يُقْتَلُونَ. فَطَلَبُوا دَانِيآلَ وَأَصْحَابَهُ لِيَقْتُلُوهُمْ.
verses.kjv: And the decree went forth that the wise [men] should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.
verses.web: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ أَجَابَ دَانِيآلُ بِحِكْمَةٍ وَعَقْلٍ لِأَرْيُوخَ رَئِيسِ شُرَطِ ٱلْمَلِكِ ٱلَّذِي خَرَجَ لِيَقْتُلَ حُكَمَاءَ بَابِلَ، أَجَابَ وَقَالَ لِأَرْيُوخَ قَائِدِ ٱلْمَلِكِ:
verses.kjv: ¶ Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise [men] of Babylon:
verses.web: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.

verses.ar: «لِمَاذَا ٱشْتَدَّ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِنْ قِبَلِ ٱلْمَلِكِ؟» حِينَئِذٍ أَخْبَرَ أَرْيُوخُ دَانِيآلَ بِٱلْأَمْرِ.
verses.kjv: He answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, Why [is] the decree [so] hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
verses.web: He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

verses.ar: فَدَخَلَ دَانِيآلُ وَطَلَبَ مِنَ ٱلْمَلِكِ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُ وَقْتًا فَيُبَيِّنُ لِلْمَلِكِ ٱلتَّعْبِيرَ.
verses.kjv: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.
verses.web: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ مَضَى دَانِيآلُ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ، وَأَعْلَمَ حَنَنْيَا وَمِيشَائِيلَ وَعَزَرْيَا أَصْحَابَهُ بِٱلْأَمْرِ،
verses.kjv: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
verses.web: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

verses.ar: لِيَطْلُبُوا ٱلْمَرَاحِمَ مِنْ قِبَلِ إِلَهِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ مِنْ جِهَةِ هَذَا ٱلسِّرِّ، لِكَيْ لَا يَهْلِكَ دَانِيآلُ وَأَصْحَابُهُ مَعَ سَائِرِ حُكَمَاءِ بَابِلَ.
verses.kjv: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise [men] of Babylon.
verses.web: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ لِدَانِيآلَ كُشِفَ ٱلسِّرُّ فِي رُؤْيَا ٱللَّيْلِ. فَبَارَكَ دَانِيآلُ إِلَهَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
verses.web: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

verses.ar: أَجَابَ دَانِيآلُ وَقَالَ: «لِيَكُنِ ٱسْمُ ٱللهِ مُبَارَكًا مِنَ ٱلْأَزَلِ وَإِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ، لِأَنَّ لَهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلْجَبَرُوتَ.
verses.kjv: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
verses.web: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ يُغَيِّرُ ٱلْأَوْقَاتَ وَٱلْأَزْمِنَةَ. يَعْزِلُ مُلُوكًا وَيُنَصِّبُ مُلُوكًا. يُعْطِي ٱلْحُكَمَاءَ حِكْمَةً، وَيُعَلِّمُ ٱلْعَارِفِينَ فَهْمًا.
verses.kjv: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:
verses.web: He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding.

verses.ar: هُوَ يَكْشِفُ ٱلْعَمَائِقَ وَٱلْأَسْرَارَ. يَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ فِي ٱلظُّلْمَةِ، وَعِنْدَهُ يَسْكُنُ ٱلنُّورُ.
verses.kjv: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what [is] in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
verses.web: He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

verses.ar: إِيَّاكَ يَا إِلَهَ آبَائِي أَحْمَدُ، وَأُسَبِّحُ ٱلَّذِي أَعْطَانِي ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلْقُوَّةَ وَأَعْلَمَنِي ٱلْآنَ مَا طَلَبْنَاهُ مِنْكَ، لِأَنَّكَ أَعْلَمْتَنَا أَمْرَ ٱلْمَلِكِ».
verses.kjv: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast [now] made known unto us the king’s matter.
verses.web: I thank you and praise you, O God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we desired of you; for you have made known to us the king’s matter.”

verses.ar: فَمِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ دَخَلَ دَانِيآلُ إِلَى أَرْيُوخَ ٱلَّذِي عَيَّنَهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ لِإِبَادَةِ حُكَمَاءِ بَابِلَ، مَضَى وَقَالَ لَهُ هَكَذَا: «لَا تُبِدْ حُكَمَاءَ بَابِلَ. أَدْخِلْنِي إِلَى قُدَّامِ ٱلْمَلِكِ فَأُبَيِّنَ لِلْمَلِكِ ٱلتَّعْبِيرَ».
verses.kjv: ¶ Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise [men] of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise [men] of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.
verses.web: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said this to him: “Don’t destroy the wise men of Babylon. Bring me in before the king, and I will show to the king the interpretation.”

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ دَخَلَ أَرْيُوخُ بِدَانِيآلَ إِلَى قُدَّامِ ٱلْمَلِكِ مُسْرِعًا وَقَالَ لَهُ هَكَذَا: «قَدْ وَجَدْتُ رَجُلًا مِنْ بَنِي سَبْيِ يَهُوذَا ٱلَّذِي يُعَرِّفُ ٱلْمَلِكَ بِٱلتَّعْبِيرِ».
verses.kjv: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.
verses.web: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said this to him: “I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah who will make known to the king the interpretation.”

verses.ar: أَجَابَ ٱلْمَلِكُ وَقَالَ لِدَانِيآلَ، ٱلَّذِي ٱسْمُهُ بَلْطَشَاصَّرُ: «هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْتَ عَلَى أَنْ تُعَرِّفَنِي بِٱلْحُلْمِ ٱلَّذِي رَأَيْتُ، وَبِتَعْبِيرِهِ؟»
verses.kjv: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name [was] Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?
verses.web: The king answered Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?”

verses.ar: أَجَابَ دَانِيآلُ قُدَّامَ ٱلْمَلِكِ وَقَالَ: «ٱلسِّرُّ ٱلَّذِي طَلَبَهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ لَا تَقْدِرُ ٱلْحُكَمَاءُ وَلَا ٱلسَّحَرَةُ وَلَا ٱلْمَجُوسُ وَلَا ٱلْمُنَجِّمُونَ عَلَى أَنْ يُبَيِّنُوهُ لِلْمَلِكِ.
verses.kjv: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise [men], the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;
verses.web: Daniel answered before the king, and said, “The secret which the king has demanded can’t be shown to the king by wise men, enchanters, magicians, or soothsayers;

verses.ar: لَكِنْ يُوجَدُ إِلَهٌ فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ كَاشِفُ ٱلْأَسْرَارِ، وَقَدْ عَرَّفَ ٱلْمَلِكَ نَبُوخَذْنَصَّرَ مَا يَكُونُ فِي ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْأَخِيرَةِ. حُلْمُكَ وَرُؤْيَا رَأْسِكَ عَلَى فِرَاشِكَ هُوَ هَذَا:
verses.kjv: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;
verses.web: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream and the visions of your head on your bed are these:

verses.ar: أَنْتَ يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلِكُ أَفْكَارُكَ عَلَى فِرَاشِكَ صَعِدَتْ إِلَى مَا يَكُونُ مِنْ بَعْدِ هَذَا، وَكَاشِفُ ٱلْأَسْرَارِ يُعَرِّفُكَ بِمَا يَكُونُ.
verses.kjv: As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came [into thy mind] upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.
verses.web: “As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَلَمْ يُكْشَفْ لِي هَذَا ٱلسِّرُّ لِحِكْمَةٍ فِيَّ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ، وَلَكِنْ لِكَيْ يُعَرَّفَ ٱلْمَلِكُ بِٱلتَّعْبِيرِ، وَلِكَيْ تَعْلَمَ أَفْكَارَ قَلْبِكَ.
verses.kjv: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for [any] wisdom that I have more than any living, but for [their] sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart.
verses.web: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.

verses.ar: «أَنْتَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلِكُ كُنْتَ تَنْظُرُ وَإِذَا بِتِمْثَالٍ عَظِيمٍ. هَذَا ٱلتِّمْثَالُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ٱلْبَهِيُّ جِدًّا وَقَفَ قُبَالَتَكَ، وَمَنْظَرُهُ هَائِلٌ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness [was] excellent, stood before thee; and the form thereof [was] terrible.
verses.web: “You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying.

verses.ar: رَأْسُ هَذَا ٱلتِّمْثَالِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ جَيِّدٍ. صَدْرُهُ وَذِرَاعَاهُ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ. بَطْنُهُ وَفَخْذَاهُ مِنْ نُحَاسٍ.
verses.kjv: This image’s head [was] of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,
verses.web: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,

verses.ar: سَاقَاهُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ. قَدَمَاهُ بَعْضُهُمَا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ وَٱلْبَعْضُ مِنْ خَزَفٍ.
verses.kjv: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
verses.web: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron and part of clay.

verses.ar: كُنْتَ تَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَنْ قُطِعَ حَجَرٌ بِغَيْرِ يَدَيْنِ، فَضَرَبَ ٱلتِّمْثَالَ عَلَى قَدَمَيْهِ ٱللَّتَيْنِ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ وَخَزَفٍ فَسَحَقَهُمَا.
verses.kjv: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet [that were] of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.
verses.web: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.

verses.ar: فَٱنْسَحَقَ حِينَئِذٍ ٱلْحَدِيدُ وَٱلْخَزَفُ وَٱلنُّحَاسُ وَٱلْفِضَّةُ وَٱلذَّهَبُ مَعًا، وَصَارَتْ كَعُصَافَةِ ٱلْبَيْدَرِ فِي ٱلصَّيْفِ، فَحَمَلَتْهَا ٱلرِّيحُ فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ لَهَا مَكَانٌ. أَمَّا ٱلْحَجَرُ ٱلَّذِي ضَرَبَ ٱلتِّمْثَالَ فَصَارَ جَبَلًا كَبِيرًا وَمَلَأَ ٱلْأَرْضَ كُلَّهَا.
verses.kjv: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.
verses.web: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors. The wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.

verses.ar: هَذَا هُوَ ٱلْحُلْمُ. فَنُخْبِرُ بِتَعْبِيرِهِ قُدَّامَ ٱلْمَلِكِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ This [is] the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
verses.web: “This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.

verses.ar: «أَنْتَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلِكُ مَلِكُ مُلُوكٍ، لِأَنَّ إِلَهَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ أَعْطَاكَ مَمْلَكَةً وَٱقْتِدَارًا وَسُلْطَانًا وَفَخْرًا.
verses.kjv: Thou, O king, [art] a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
verses.web: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

verses.ar: وَحَيْثُمَا يَسْكُنُ بَنُو ٱلْبَشَرِ وَوُحُوشُ ٱلْبَرِّ وَطُيُورُ ٱلسَّمَاءِ دَفَعَهَا لِيَدِكَ وَسَلَّطَكَ عَلَيْهَا جَمِيعِهَا. فَأَنْتَ هَذَا ٱلرَّأْسُ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ.
verses.kjv: And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou [art] this head of gold.
verses.web: Wherever the children of men dwell, he has given the animals of the field and the birds of the sky into your hand, and has made you rule over them all. You are the head of gold.

verses.ar: وَبَعْدَكَ تَقُومُ مَمْلَكَةٌ أُخْرَى أَصْغَرُ مِنْكَ وَمَمْلَكَةٌ ثَالِثَةٌ أُخْرَى مِنْ نُحَاسٍ فَتَتَسَلَّطُ عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.
verses.web: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ مَمْلَكَةٌ رَابِعَةٌ صَلْبَةٌ كَٱلْحَدِيدِ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْحَدِيدَ يَدُقُّ وَيَسْحَقُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ. وَكَالْحَدِيدِ ٱلَّذِي يُكَسِّرُ تَسْحَقُ وَتُكَسِّرُ كُلَّ هَؤُلَاءِ.
verses.kjv: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all [things:] and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.
verses.web: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush.

verses.ar: وَبِمَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلْقَدَمَيْنِ وَٱلْأَصَابِعَ بَعْضُهَا مِنْ خَزَفٍ وَٱلْبَعْضُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، فَٱلْمَمْلَكَةُ تَكُونُ مُنْقَسِمَةً، وَيَكُونُ فِيهَا قُوَّةُ ٱلْحَدِيدِ مِنْ حَيْثُ إِنَّكَ رَأَيْتَ ٱلْحَدِيدَ مُخْتَلِطًا بِخَزَفِ ٱلطِّينِ.
verses.kjv: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay.
verses.web: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.

verses.ar: وَأَصَابِعُ ٱلْقَدَمَيْنِ بَعْضُهَا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ وَٱلْبَعْضُ مِنْ خَزَفٍ، فَبَعْضُ ٱلْمَمْلَكَةِ يَكُونُ قَوِيًّا وَٱلْبَعْضُ قَصِمًا.
verses.kjv: And [as] the toes of the feet [were] part of iron, and part of clay, [so] the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
verses.web: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.

verses.ar: وَبِمَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلْحَدِيدَ مُخْتَلِطًا بِخَزَفِ ٱلطِّينِ، فَإِنَّهُمْ يَخْتَلِطُونَ بِنَسْلِ ٱلنَّاسِ، وَلَكِنْ لَا يَتَلَاصَقُ هَذَا بِذَاكَ، كَمَا أَنَّ ٱلْحَدِيدَ لَا يَخْتَلِطُ بِٱلْخَزَفِ.
verses.kjv: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.
verses.web: Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they will mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they won’t cling to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.

verses.ar: وَفِي أَيَّامِ هَؤُلَاءِ ٱلْمُلُوكِ، يُقِيمُ إِلَهُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ مَمْلَكَةً لَنْ تَنْقَرِضَ أَبَدًا، وَمَلِكُهَا لَا يُتْرَكُ لِشَعْبٍ آخَرَ، وَتَسْحَقُ وَتُفْنِي كُلَّ هَذِهِ ٱلْمَمَالِكِ، وَهِيَ تَثْبُتُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, [but] it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.
verses.web: “In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ رَأَيْتَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ قُطِعَ حَجَرٌ مِنْ جَبَلٍ لَا بِيَدَيْنِ، فَسَحَقَ ٱلْحَدِيدَ وَٱلنُّحَاسَ وَٱلْخَزَفَ وَٱلْفِضَّةَ وَٱلذَّهَبَ. ٱللهُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ قَدْ عَرَّفَ ٱلْمَلِكَ مَا سَيَأْتِي بَعْدَ هَذَا. اَلْحُلْمُ حَقٌّ وَتَعْبِيرُهُ يَقِينٌ».
verses.kjv: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream [is] certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.
verses.web: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.”

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ خَرَّ نَبُوخَذْنَصَّرُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ وَسَجَدَ لِدَانِيآلَ، وَأَمَرَ بِأَنْ يُقَدِّمُوا لَهُ تَقْدِمَةً وَرَوَائِحَ سُرُورٍ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.
verses.web: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.

verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ ٱلْمَلِكُ دَانِيآلَ وَقَالَ: «حَقًّا إِنَّ إِلَهَكُمْ إِلَهُ ٱلْآلِهَةِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمُلُوكِ وَكَاشِفُ ٱلْأَسْرَارِ، إِذِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ عَلَى كَشْفِ هَذَا ٱلسِّرِّ».
verses.kjv: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth [it is], that your God [is] a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.
verses.web: The king answered to Daniel, and said, “Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret.”

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ عَظَّمَ ٱلْمَلِكُ دَانِيآلَ وَأَعْطَاهُ عَطَايَا كَثِيرَةً، وَسَلَّطَهُ عَلَى كُلِّ وِلَايَةِ بَابِلَ وَجَعَلَهُ رَئِيسَ ٱلشِّحَنِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ حُكَمَاءِ بَابِلَ.
verses.kjv: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise [men] of Babylon.
verses.web: Then the king made Daniel great and gave him many great gifts, and made him rule over the whole province of Babylon and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.

verses.ar: فَطَلَبَ دَانِيآلُ مِنَ ٱلْمَلِكِ، فَوَلَّى شَدْرَخَ وَمِيشَخَ وَعَبْدَنَغُوَ عَلَى أَعْمَالِ وِلَايَةِ بَابِلَ. أَمَّا دَانِيآلُ فَكَانَ فِي بَابِ ٱلْمَلِكِ.
verses.kjv: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel [sat] in the gate of the king.
verses.web: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon, but Daniel was in the king’s gate.
